hero.headline: Junk Removal & Dumpster Rentals in Northville, MI
hero.subheadline: From garage cleanouts and junk removal to dumpster rentals and debris hauling, Dumpstar Quality Rental & Removal makes clearing your property simple. Proudly serving Northville and surrounding Michigan communities.

about.title: Locally Operated. Straightforward Service.
about.body:
Dumpstar Quality Rental & Removal is a locally operated junk removal and dumpster rental business based in Northville, Michigan. We focus on dependable service, straightforward communication, and helping you reclaim your space.

Whether you're a homeowner clearing out a garage, a contractor managing job-site debris, a property manager preparing a unit, or a business that needs a cleanup, we're here to make the process simple.

faqs.a: We offer junk removal, dumpster rentals, garage and property cleanouts, demolition and debris removal, and material pickup and delivery.

faqs.q: What size are your dumpster rentals?
faqs.a: Our dumpster rentals are 15-yard dumpster trailers, a practical fit for renovations, cleanouts, construction projects, and property cleanup.
We serve Northville, Novi, Livonia, Plymouth, Canton, and South Lyon, Michigan. If you're nearby and don't see your town listed, give us a call and ask.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Fill out the free quote form on this page or call (734) 747-0543. Tell us what you need, where the project is, and any details about the job. We're open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
We work with homeowners, contractors, property managers, and businesses.
